## How to use this library

I spend a lot of time looking at tadpoles, either in the field or in museums. Many tadpoles don't have published photos, so I hope people find this resource useful. Search taxonomy below and hover over a photograph to see what it is. Click it to open it full size.

These images are free to use for teaching, identification keys, and
research papers. Please [ask first](contact.qmd) so I can send you a version
without the watermark, and credit them to Jackson R. Phillips.
